title: Sunfox Technologies appoints Subrata Mazumdar as VP – Strategy & Growth
summary: The appointment follows the company’s US$7 million Series A funding round and will see Mazumdar lead its growth strategy, market expansion and strategic partnerships

contentHtml:
The appointment follows the company’s US$7 million Series A funding round and will see Mazumdar lead its growth strategy, market expansion and strategic partnerships

Sunfox Technologies, the Dehradun-based medtech company behind Spandan, its portable electrocardiogram (ECG) platform, has appointed Subrata Mazumdar as Vice President – Strategy & Growth.

Based in Mumbai, Mazumdar will report to Rajat Jain, Founder and CEO, and lead the company’s strategic growth initiatives as it enters its next phase of expansion. The appointment follows Sunfox Technologies’ US$7 million Series A funding round, led by Ashish Kacholia, Lashit Sanghvi, Alchemy Capital and 3one4 Capital.

In his new role, Mazumdar will drive Sunfox’s growth strategy over the next three years, focusing on market expansion, portfolio strategy, go-to-market (GTM) planning, pricing and strategic partnerships. He will also align market access and sales initiatives to build scalable growth pathways for the company.

Mazumdar brings over three decades of commercial leadership experience across medtech, pharmaceuticals and consumer health at Abbott, Sanofi, Novartis, Claris Lifesciences and Wockhardt. During his over 15 years at Abbott Diabetes Care, he rose to become Associate Director – Commercial for India. At Abbott, he led the launch of FreeStyle Libre and Libre Pro, India’s first Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) technology, building the category from zero to a category leader.

He holds an MBA from NIBM, a postgraduate diploma in Retail Management from Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies, and a BSc (Hons) in Zoology from the University of Calcutta.

“With our Series A in place, our focus is to scale Spandan with discipline, choosing the right channels, partners and markets. Subrata took a technology India had never seen and turned it into a category leader. He is the right leader for our next stage of growth,” said Rajat Jain, Founder and CEO, Sunfox Technologies.

“Sunfox has built an affordable ECG platform that reaches more than 20,000 villages. I see the same opportunity here as we saw with CGM: to make accessible cardiac screening a standard of care. My priority is to build scalable growth channels that take Spandan into many more homes, clinics and health systems worldwide,” said Subrata Mazumdar, Vice President – Strategy & Growth, Sunfox Technologies.
